annotations.title: House building cost in Poland: replacement cost per m2 and construction prices (voivodes, BGK, GUS)

description: Use for how much it costs to build a house in Poland, the cost of building 1 m2 in a voivodeship, the official replacement cost indicator (koszt odtworzenia 1 m2) announced by voivodes, and how construction prices change (GUS). For flat prices, use get_housing_prices; for BGK price limits of the family housing loan, use get_rkm_price_limits. What building a house costs in Poland according to official indicators, and the reference sum insured for the building in home insurance (replacement cost x floor area). Replacement cost of 1 m2 of a residential building announced by each voivode every half year (average of the two latest announcements, derived from BGK family housing loan limits): voivodeship city, the municipalities bordering it and the other municipalities of the voivodeship. Gives a 120 m2 house per voivodeship and its change in a year, Koszt budowy domu finwire (finwire_house_build_cost: a 120 m2 house at the middle value of the 16 voivodeships), an optional estimate for your floor area, and GUS construction and assembly price indices (m/m and y/y, construction of buildings and other divisions). The replacement cost is an official indicator, not a contractor quote: a real house can cost more or less depending on the project, standard and materials, and the plot is not included.

area_m2.description: Usable floor area of the house in m2 for an estimate (needs voivodeship).

history.description: Number of past months of GUS construction prices in the summary, default 6.

location.description: Part of the voivodeship for the estimate: rest = other municipalities (default), neighbors = municipalities bordering the voivodeship city, city = the voivodeship city.

voivodeship.description: Voivodeship slug, name or voivodeship city, e.g. malopolskie or Kraków; default all 16.
